GTFSwizard is a set of tools for creating, exploring, and manipulating
[General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS)](https://gtfs.org/) files in
R.

Its main purpose is to give researchers and practitioners a
straightforward way to explore and simulate changes within GTFS files,
which represent public transportation schedules and geographic data.

## Install

``` r

# Stable release
install.packages("GTFSwizard")

# Development version
remotes::install_github(
  "nelsonquesado/GTFSwizard@main"
)
```

## Work With GTFS

- **Create and validate:** build feeds from data frames with
  [`create_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/create_gtfs.md),
  or import an existing archive with
  [`read_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/read_gtfs.md).
  Check the original archive against the GTFS specification with
  [`validate_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/validate_gtfs.md).
- **Analyze service:** calculate frequency, headways, dwell time,
  duration, speed, fleet requirements, service span, corridors, and
  hubs.
- **Build scenarios:** filter routes, services, dates, stops, and time
  windows; then delay, split, merge, or edit scheduled trips.
- **Explore visually:** use
  [`explore_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/explore_gtfs.md)
  for interactive maps, planning indicators, service plots, editing, and
  export.

## Quick Start

The package includes compact rail and larger bus feeds, so the main
workflows can be tried without downloading external data.

``` r

library(GTFSwizard)

gtfs <- for_rail_gtfs
summary(gtfs)

get_frequency(gtfs, method = "by_route")
plot_calendar(gtfs, fill = "service_pattern", facet_by_year = TRUE)
```

Launch the dashboard from an object, or omit the object to choose a GTFS
zip archive interactively.

``` r

explore_gtfs(for_rail_gtfs)
# explore_gtfs()
```

![GTFSwizard dashboard showing a transit
network](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nelsonquesado/GTFSwizard/main/figs/exploregtfs.png)

# Package index

## Package overview

- [`GTFSwizard`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/GTFSwizard-package.md)
  [`GTFSwizard-package`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/GTFSwizard-package.md)
  : GTFSwizard: Create, Explore, and Edit GTFS Feeds

## Create, read, and export feeds

Build the GTFSwizard object used throughout the package.

- [`create_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/create_gtfs.md)
  : Create a GTFS Feed from Tables
- [`read_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/read_gtfs.md)
  : Read a GTFS Feed
- [`as_wizardgtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/as_wizardgtfs.md)
  : Convert a GTFS Feed to \`wizardgtfs\`
- [`validate_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/validate_gtfs.md)
  : Validate a GTFS Schedule Feed
- [`write_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/write_gtfs.md)
  : Write a GTFS Feed
- [`merge_gtfs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/merge_gtfs.md)
  : Merge Two GTFS Feeds

## Filter, select, and group

Focus an analysis while retaining a valid, internally consistent feed.

- [`filter_servicepattern()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/filter_functions.md)
  [`filter_date()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/filter_functions.md)
  [`filter_service()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/filter_functions.md)
  [`filter_route()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/filter_functions.md)
  [`filter_trip()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/filter_functions.md)
  [`filter_stop()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/filter_functions.md)
  [`filter_time()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/filter_functions.md)
  : Filter a GTFS Feed
- [`selection()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/selection.md)
  [`unselection()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/selection.md)
  : Group or Select GTFS Records Without Filtering the Feed

## Analyze scheduled service

Calculate service patterns and planning or operational indicators.

- [`get_servicepattern()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_servicepattern.md)
  : Identify Recurring Daily Service Patterns
- [`get_frequency()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_frequency.md)
  : Calculate Scheduled Service Frequency
- [`get_headways()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_headways.md)
  : Calculate Scheduled Headways
- [`get_dwelltimes()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_dwelltimes.md)
  : Calculate Dwell Times in GTFS Data
- [`get_durations()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_durations.md)
  : Calculate Trip Durations in GTFS Data
- [`get_distances()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_distances.md)
  : Calculate Distances in GTFS Data
- [`get_speeds()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_speeds.md)
  : Calculate Scheduled Speeds
- [`get_fleet()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_fleet.md)
  : Estimate Simultaneous Vehicles
- [`get_1stdeparture()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_1stdeparture.md)
  : Get the First Departure of Each Trip

## Analyze geography and networks

Work with stops, shapes, corridors, hubs, and metric coordinate systems.

- [`get_stops_sf()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_stops_sf.md)
  : Convert GTFS Stops to Simple Features
- [`get_shapes()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_shapes.md)
  : Infer Straight-Line Shapes from Stop Sequences
- [`get_shapes_sf()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_shapes_sf.md)
  : Convert GTFS Shapes to Simple Features
- [`get_shapes_df()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_shapes_df.md)
  : Convert Shape Geometries to a GTFS Shapes Table
- [`latlon2epsg()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/latlon2epsg.md)
  : Transform Spatial Data to a Local Metric CRS
- [`get_corridor()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_corridor.md)
  : Identify High-Frequency Transit Corridors
- [`get_hubs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/get_hubs.md)
  : Identify Stops Serving Multiple Routes

## Edit scheduled service

Apply timetable and trip-structure scenarios to a copy of a feed.

- [`delay_trip()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/delay_trip.md)
  : Shift Trips in Time
- [`split_trip()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/split_trip.md)
  : Split Trips into Consecutive Parts
- [`edit_speed()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/edit_speed.md)
  : Scale In-Vehicle Travel Speed
- [`set_dwelltime()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/set_dwelltime.md)
  : Set Dwell Times
- [`edit_dwelltime()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/edit_dwelltime.md)
  : Scale Dwell Times

## Visualize feeds and service

Produce the package’s consistent static network and service plots.

- [`print(`*`<wizardgtfs>`*`)`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/wizardgtfs-methods.md)
  [`summary(`*`<wizardgtfs>`*`)`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/wizardgtfs-methods.md)
  [`print(`*`<summary.wizardgtfs>`*`)`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/wizardgtfs-methods.md)
  [`plot(`*`<wizardgtfs>`*`)`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/wizardgtfs-methods.md)
  : Print, Summarize, and Plot \`wizardgtfs\` Objects
- [`plot_calendar()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_calendar.md)
  : Plot the GTFS Service Calendar
- [`plot_frequency()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_frequency.md)
  : Plot System Frequency by Hour
- [`plot_routefrequency()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_routefrequency.md)
  : Plot Route Frequency by Hour
- [`plot_headways()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_headways.md)
  : Plot System Headway by Hour
- [`plot_servicespan()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_servicespan.md)
  : Plot Scheduled Service Span by Route
- [`plot_serviceheatmap()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_serviceheatmap.md)
  : Plot Average Scheduled Departures by Weekday and Hour
- [`plot_routeduration()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_routeduration.md)
  : Plot Scheduled Trip Duration by Route
- [`plot_servicesupply()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_servicesupply.md)
  : Plot Scheduled Vehicle-Hours by Route
- [`plot_corridor()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_corridor.md)
  : Plot High-Frequency Corridors
- [`plot_hubs()`](https://nelsonquesado.github.io/GTFSwizard/reference/plot_hubs.md)
  : Plot Transit Hubs
